references.context: Module theory: finite-rank free left R-module R^n over a unital ring R for finite n≥0, the direct sum of n copies of the regular left R-module, with its canonical standard basis; not the same as an arbitrary locally free module.
references.matching_note: The finite direct sum R^n is the finite-rank free module, not merely a finitely generated module or a locally free module. The rank or multiplicity n remains part of each source.
